attributes.title: WOCNext 2027
attributes.organizer: Wound, Ostomy, and Continence Nurses Society
attributes.summary:
WOC nurses and others in wound, ostomy, continence and foot care head to Savannah on June 14 to 16, 2027. The format mixes 30- to 90-minute sessions, ePosters and sponsored symposia. Among the symposia, only select sessions carry contact hours, so check before you sign up for one.

WOCN is a California BRN provider (CEP 15115), but the 2027 contact-hour total and the venue are not published yet. Registration opens mid-February 2027.
